meta.title: Mobile View: Mobile Simulator & Responsive Tester for Chrome
meta.description: Test a website on up to four phone, tablet, and desktop viewports side by side. Free Chrome extension with synced scrolling, screenshots, and localhost support.
meta.ogTitle: Mobile View: test your website on multiple devices at once

hero.title: Test your website on multiple devices at once.
hero.lede: Preview mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts side by side in Chrome. Compare up to four synced viewports, even on localhost, with a free mobile simulator.

faq.title: Questions.
faq.a1: Yes. Free and open source under the MIT license, with no account.
faq.a2: Yes. Start your development server, open its localhost URL in Chrome, and launch Mobile View from that tab. You can compare mobile and desktop layouts before deploying.
faq.q3: How is it different from DevTools device mode?
faq.a3: Chrome DevTools is useful for debugging one mobile viewport. Mobile View keeps up to four device-sized previews visible side by side and can sync scrolling, clicks, and navigation.
faq.a4: Some sites block being shown inside another page. Mobile View tells you and offers to open them in a tab.
faq.q5: Does the fix prompt upload my code?
faq.a5: No. It is written on your machine for you to paste into your own coding tool.
